race.description: Buy Your Kosciuszko Tickets Mdn Plate
race.comment: POETIC WAY (4) progressed nicely last time out to finish just 0.7 lengths from the winner in second over 1120m at Dubbo after being in the firing line on the bend. Must be included in calculations. BLOOMIN' HELL (8) missed the placings two runs back then did well last start but found one better over 1320m at Dubbo, beaten only a long neck. Nicely placed to give this a mighty shake. COOL NANCZYE (10) was out of the money two runs back then again missed the frame last start over 1200m at Gilgandra, beaten 1.75 lengths into fifth. Meets some better types this time but a better run will not surprise. LONG TIME LOVERS (11) hasn't been far away recently and is worth including.
